11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

223|6cf6bf68.name: Dan Golthas
223|6cf6bf68.text: Take every word I say and commit it to memory. Until our enemies have been eradicated, we must never shirk a chance to further our knowledge. Reinforce your armor, and never relax your guard.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

3549|d12ffcb8.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|d12ffcb8.text: Before the plague came, I knew nothing about leather. Now I know enough to teach others. Death's left me with a lot of time on my hands.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4573|c2467ddc.name: Armand Cromwell
4573|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

4582|0deb5cc3.name: Carolyn Ward
4582|0deb5cc3.text: With the sanction of Lord Varimathras, the Deathstalkers' numbers grow. More blades to strike at our enemies when they least expect it.

5624|89fbd152.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|89fbd152.text: Archibald who you look for.  He outside weapon merchant shop on inner ring of War Quarter.

5624|e2112670.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|e2112670.text: Arthur Moore in Rogues' Quarter inner ring is one who teach leatherworking.

5690|c2467ddc.name: Clyde Kellen
5690|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6497|1668563d.name: Astor Hadren
6497|1668563d.text: What do you want, $c? I'm running late, and my employer doesn't look kindly on tardiness.

6497|9478c611.name: Astor Hadren
6497|9478c611.text: Yes, I am. What's it to you?

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

1358-accept.name: Apothecary Zinge
1358-accept.text:
A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.  He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

Helbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads.  To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar.  Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
1358-accept.title: Sample for Helbrim

1359-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1359-accept.text:
The wolf hearts you acquired possess a quality unseen in similar specimens.  There is a toxicity to them that should be deadly to the very wolves in which the hearts beat!

It's quite incredible, and we must study it further.  I kept a few samples of the hearts acquired.  Take them to my colleague, Apothecary Zinge.  You will find her in our headquarters in the Undercity.
1359-accept.title: Zinge's Delivery

1359-complete.name: Apothecary Zinge
1359-complete.text: Ah yes, the heart samples of which Renferrel spoke.  I am eager to experiment with these... it is always of interest to the Royal Apothecary Society when new forms of toxins are discovered.
1359-complete.title: Zinge's Delivery

1886-complete.name: Mennet Carkad
1886-complete.text: Well done, $N. You've passed the first part of this test. Hopefully Andron will not have caught wind of your activities, and we will be able to convince him that you are, in fact, the messenger he is expecting.
1886-complete.title: The Deathstalkers

1898-accept.name: Mennet Carkad
1898-accept.text:
The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.

Lord Varimathras suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.

I want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.
1898-accept.title: The Deathstalkers

1898-complete.name: Andron Gant
1898-complete.text:
Ah, yes, I've been expecting you. I have no doubt our mutual acquaintances are pleased with the information that I have provided so far?

I suppose there's no point in asking you, I doubt they would burden you with this knowledge. Why place so much trust in the messenger, hm?
1898-complete.title: The Deathstalkers

1898-progress.name: Andron Gant
1898-progress.text: Hello. Something I can do for you?
1898-progress.title: The Deathstalkers

1899-accept.name: Andron Gant
1899-accept.text: You'll find the ledger with the information your employers seek on the bookshelf behind me. Deliver it with my regards, and tell them that I would prefer it if they sent you, if they find enough value that they should wish to continue our arrangement.
1899-accept.title: The Deathstalkers

1899-complete.name: Mennet Carkad
1899-complete.text: Well, this is certainly more information than I suspected to get out of Andron. Give me a moment to peruse it, before I set you to your next task.
1899-complete.title: The Deathstalkers

1978-accept.name: Mennet Carkad
1978-accept.text:
The Syndicate? I would never have suspected. It seems the lords of Alterac have fallen far in the years since their betrayal.

Lord Varimathras will be pleased to learn of this, and as you were so instrumental in this discovery, it would be fitting if you were the one to deliver it to him.

Ah, and how could I forget?

Welcome to the Deathstalkers.
1978-accept.title: The Deathstalkers

1978-complete.name: Varimathras
1978-complete.text:
Hmm, this is interesting. The Deathstalkers have performed their duties admirably in ferreting this out.

From what I understand, you also deserve commendation for your performance. I hope that this will become routine for you, $N, my Deathstalkers always have use of a good woman.
1978-complete.title: The Deathstalkers

3221-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
3221-accept.text: While you were out helping our deathstalkers, Apothecary Renferrel sent you a summons.  He did not give me details, but he wanted to speak with you about the wolf hearts you had given him.
3221-accept.title: Speak with Renferrel

3221-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
3221-complete.text: Ah, very good.  There is a matter regarding the wolf hearts you brought to me earlier that demands our attention.
3221-complete.title: Speak with Renferrel

366-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-complete.text:
My book?!?  So you were the thief who stole it!

But...what is this new enchantment upon it...Bethor?  He is in  Lordaeron?

If he still exists, then perhaps he too escaped from the Lich King's grasp...
366-complete.title: Return the Book

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

372-complete.name: Executor Zygand
372-complete.text: You have done extremely well, $c.  With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The Forsaken our race is one step closer to defeating Arthas once and for all.  I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
372-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

408-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-complete.text:
Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge.  And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the Forsaken, nor by our enemies.

Continue the struggle as we all do, $N, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from Azeroth!
408-complete.title: The Family Crypt

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

409-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-accept.text:
You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this.  But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.

There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island.  it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara.

Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here.  Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake.  Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
409-accept.title: Proving Allegiance

409-complete.name: Gunther Arcanus
409-complete.text:
You have defeated Lillith Nefara, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge.  Incredible.

I had believed I was the only $R with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
409-complete.title: Proving Allegiance

410-complete.name: Unknown
410-complete.text: You place the Candle of Beckoning upon the table and light it...
410-complete.title: The Dormant Shade

410-progress.name: Unknown
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-accept.name: Gunther Arcanus
411-accept.text: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor.  It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
411-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-complete.text: You convinced him to join us!  You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, $N.  The Dark Lady will be informed.
411-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

421-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-accept.text:
Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.

But that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

I need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess.  Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.  The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
421-accept.title: Prove Your Worth

421-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
421-complete.text: You have served me well, $c.  It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.
421-complete.title: Prove Your Worth

422-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-accept.text:
How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.

What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
422-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

422-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-complete.text: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, $c.  If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
422-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

422-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
422-progress.text: Before I know what we are dealing with here, $c, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal.  Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
422-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

423-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-accept.text:
After examining Arugal's work my worst suspicions were confirmed.  The old hack was not qualified to clean chamber pots in Dalaran let alone represent the Kirin Tor in its most dire hour.  Fools!

Arugal used enchanted items to reinforce his weak magic.  I need to examine these items first hand.  Travel forth and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have collected enough of their enchanted shackles for my research.  The foul creatures have been seen to the north and east.
423-accept.title: Arugal's Folly

428-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
428-accept.text:
A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.

They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.

Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.
428-accept.title: Lost Deathstalkers

428-complete.name: Rane Yorick
428-complete.text: You found us!  And not a moment too soon...
428-complete.title: Lost Deathstalkers

429-accept.name: Rane Yorick
429-accept.text:
My brother Quinn was badly hurt by the ghoul, Ivar the Foul, and I don't know if he will heal properly without alchemical aid.  Although I am not an apothecary, I do know that our apothecaries can make healing potions from the discolored hearts of worgs.

Gather such hearts and take them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher to the south.  Then return here with the potion.

You can find plenty of worgs between here and Malden's Orchard to the east.
429-accept.title: Wild Hearts

429-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-complete.text:
<Renferrel takes the hearts.>

It is troubling to hear our Deathstalkers have failed their mission.

Let us hope that these failures are rare.

I'll give you the potion in a moment.
429-complete.title: Wild Hearts

429-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
429-progress.text: My time is short, $c, for the Dark Lady has charged me with a grave task.
429-progress.title: Wild Hearts

430-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
430-accept.text:
Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery.

Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
430-accept.title: Return to Quinn

431-complete.name: Unknown
431-complete.text: You grab one of the candles and place it in your pack.
431-complete.title: Candles of Beckoning

435-accept.name: Deathstalker Erland
435-accept.text:
The wolves outside won't leave, and they eye me evilly every time I step foot out that door.  They must be incredibly hungry to think I'm worth eating.

I have to report to my teammate, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick.  And to get to Rane, I'll need help against those wolves.

Please escort me!  And there are a lot of wolves out there, so we'll have a better chance if you have friends who can help...
435-accept.title: Escorting Erland

435-complete.name: Rane Yorick
435-complete.text: Thank you for the aid, $N.  I had feared Erland was overcome by the dangers of Silverpine.  With your help, I see that he has not.
435-complete.title: Escorting Erland

437-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-accept.text:
Our initial scouting reports of Silverpine show the rot hides have a base at an old farm to the north, the Dead Fields.  We have sent small assaults against them, but each time they are reinforced by the banshee Nightlash, who uses her magic to rout our forces.

We want Nightlash destroyed.

Go to the Dead Fields and assault the rot hides.  If you don't see Nightlash then kill the rot hides until she appears, then defeat her.

Her essence will turn to dust.  Bring me that dust as proof.
437-accept.title: The Dead Fields

437-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-complete.text:
I heard of your successful raid against the rot hides, $N, and this essence is proof of Nightlash's death.

The Scourge have lost ground this day.  Your value to the Forsaken grows.
437-complete.title: The Dead Fields

437-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
437-progress.text: Have you defeated Nightlash, $N?  Our success against the rot hides depends on her destruction!
437-progress.title: The Dead Fields

438-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
438-accept.text:
$N, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry.  The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other $r.

There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area.  Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.
438-accept.title: The Decrepit Ferry

438-complete.name: Unknown
438-complete.text:
Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses.  And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.

The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
438-complete.title: The Decrepit Ferry

439-accept.name: Unknown
439-accept.text:
Among the corpses a hand protrudes, unwrapped.  It is the hand of a woman, pockmarked from the plague but relatively fresh.  

On the hand is a ring.  Removing the ring and inspecting it reveals an engraving:

"For Deliah"
439-accept.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-complete.text:
You say that this ring was worn by a woman, recently killed?

The only nearby source of such a body would be the mass graves in Tirisfal.  The Rot Hide Gnolls must be taking those corpses to Fenris Isle!
439-complete.title: Rot Hide Clues

439-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
439-progress.text: $N.  You return, so I assume your investigations bore fruit?
439-progress.title: Rot Hide Clues

440-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
440-accept.text:
If you want to find the husband or beloved who gave Deliah her ring... then speak with Magistrate Sevren in Brill.  He should have records of recent deaths and, with luck, can discover who Deliah is.

But I wouldn't hope.  Whoever gave her the ring is probably dead.  Or if he's $r he probably no longer cares about Deliah.
440-accept.title: The Engraved Ring

443-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
443-accept.text:
Before we launch an assault on Fenris Isle, we must determine who is behind the rot hide gnolls.  Our apothecaries believe their origin lies within the strange fluid that flows through their bodies.

Go to Fenris Isle, east of the Decrepit Ferry, and collect rot hide ichor from the gnolls you find there.  Bring it to Apothecary Renferrel, stationed outside the Sepulcher.
443-accept.title: Rot Hide Ichor

443-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
443-progress.text: Do you have the rot hide ichor, $N?
443-progress.title: Rot Hide Ichor

445-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-complete.text:
Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research.  With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades.  Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

But you must excuse my rambling.  Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N.  We could use an able bodied $c like you around here.
445-complete.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

447-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
447-accept.text:
Arthas's numbers are overwhelming. But with a New Plague we could eradicate both the Scourge Army and the Human infestation once and for all.

My studies have proven that spider blood combined with a toxin derived from a grizzled bear heart results in a deadly elixir. Collect samples from the spiders in the Skittering Dark to the northwest and from the bears wandering throughout Silverpine Forest. Deliver the reagents to Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society in the Undercity.
447-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

447-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-complete.text: How good of Apothecary Renferrel to send you to me, $N.  These samples will indeed prove useful to the cause.  I will begin studying their toxic and contaminable properties at once.
447-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

447-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
447-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with the Royal Apothecary Society?
447-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

449-accept.name: Rane Yorick
449-accept.text: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible.  It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
449-accept.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-complete.text:
I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.

Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, $N.  And you will be commended.
449-complete.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

449-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
449-progress.text: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?
449-progress.title: The Deathstalkers' Report

450-accept.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
450-accept.text:
You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, $N.

When Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard.  Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us.  But his findings might prove to be of worth.  He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.

Retrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
450-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

477-accept.name: Shadow Priest Allister
477-accept.text:
As you may know, the town of Ambermill remains a source of human opposition, mainly through the support they receive from the wizards of Dalaran.

I don't know what their plan is, but for them to show interest in a backwater village like Ambermill indicates that it must have some greater importance.

They've been shipping crates by the wagon from Hillsbrad. Many of those supplies end up at a small camp north of Pyrewood Village. Retrieve the contents of a crate and return them to me.
477-accept.title: Border Crossings

5725-accept.name: Varimathras
5725-accept.text:
Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

A sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
5725-accept.title: The Power to Destroy...

6321-accept.name: Deathguard Podrig
6321-accept.text:
Executor Hadrec asked me to take stock of our equipment at the Sepulcher.  With the Scourge, and worse, lurking in the woods, he doesn't want the Deathguards to lack gear they might need.

I found that we are, in general, well stocked, but we do need more weapons to replace those lost in the field.

Here is a requisition order of what is needed, for the weapon dealer Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.  Take the order to our bat master, Karos Razok, and speak with him about transport to the Undercity.
6321-accept.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-complete.name: Karos Razok
6321-complete.text: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
6321-complete.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-accept.name: Gordon Wendham
6322-accept.text:
I have placed the Sepulcher's supplies into this crate.  If you have already visited the Sepulcher and spoken with their bat master, then you may ride a bat back to him.

Speak with the Undercity's bat master, Michael Garrett.  He can provide you with a bat to the Sepulcher.
6322-accept.title: Michael Garrett

6322-complete.name: Michael Garrett
6322-complete.text: This crate must reach the Sepulcher in Silverpine?  That is easily done; our bats fly there daily.
6322-complete.title: Michael Garrett

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-accept.name: Karos Razok
6323-accept.text:
One of my bats can take you to the Undercity, for a small fee.  Speak with me again when you are ready so that we may arrange your transport.

You will find Gordon Wendham in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.  That is the same quarter where my bat will land.
6323-accept.title: Ride to the Undercity

6323-complete.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-complete.text: An order from the Sepulcher?  Very well.  It is an honor to serve those who serve our Dark Lady.
6323-complete.title: Ride to the Undercity

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6324-accept.name: Michael Garrett
6324-accept.text:
The bat master in the Sepulcher is Karos Razok.  If you have already met him, then I can give you a bat to fly back to him.

Our bats will always fly to the Undercity, but to travel to more remote locales their rider must first visit the area and speak with its bat master.

You have met Karos in the Sepulcher, so you may now fly bats there.  Speak with me again when you are ready.
6324-accept.title: Return to Podrig

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

97956-complete.name: Clyde Kellen
97956-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Fish Bowl. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97956-complete.title: Camping 101: Fishing

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
